## Who he is
- L2 Technical Support / Business Analyst at Tata Consultancy Services (2022–2024), supporting GE's FieldCore project management application used by 10,000+ people worldwide.
- Handled 7–15 ServiceNow tickets a day: fixed data with SQL, traced issues in AWS CloudWatch logs and REST API payloads, verified fixes with Postman, worked directly with field technicians on events, purchase orders, scope, and resource allocation.
- Documented recurring issues, categorized them (Data Fix / Integration Issue / Manual Fix / Contract Change), and pushed automation of manual processes — ticket flow dropped by around 30% during peak support time.
- Operations Manager / Material Planner at Savli Infra Ltd. (2020–2021): ran 9-person quarry-to-delivery operations at 181 tons/day with zero missed customer deadlines for 17 months; Excel fleet analysis found 40% underutilization, cutting logistics costs 15% ($10K/year) and growing profit $30K/year.
- MS in Engineering Management, Arizona State University (2024–2026). Bachelor of Engineering, Savitribai Phule Pune University.
